name: Desomorphine
summary: Desomorphine is a opioid substance belonging to the Substituted morphinans chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Desomorphine (or in some formulations known as Krokodil) is a semi-synthetic opioid commercialized by Roche, with powerful, fast-acting effects, such as sedation and analgesia.

uses.text: The traditional synthesis of desomorphine starts from α-chlorocodide, which is itself obtained by treating codeine with thionyl chloride. A desomorphine product, usually based on codeine, has been developed as a recreational drug.
uses.recreational: Desomorphine abuse in Russia attracted international attention in 2010 due to an increase in clandestine production, presumably due to its relatively simple synthesis from codeine available over the counter. Abuse of homemade desomorphine was first reported in Siberia in 2003 when Russia started a major crackdown on heroin production and trafficking, but it has since spread throughout Russia and the neighboring former Soviet republics.
